description: Which of a snapshot, a dynaset and a table-type recordset keep a usable state across Rollback, when each is opened before the level and each is opened inside it after the level changed R? Fixture r-txn-1b-main-accdb (tables T, S, C, Lv, R, Wide, Big, saved QueryDef QInsMid), opened writable through DBEngine.OpenDatabase in Workspaces(0). Before BeginTrans: snapshot bs, dynaset bd on SELECT ID, V, Z FROM R ORDER BY ID, and table bt on R (Index PK_R), each MoveFirst. BeginTrans; DELETE FROM R WHERE ID = 1; INSERT INTO R (ID, V, Z) VALUES (9, 90, 'r9'); UPDATE R SET V = V + 1 WHERE ID = 3 (all dbFailOnError); the same three kinds again as ks, kd, kt, each MoveFirst; state of each of the six (EditMode, BOF, EOF, RecordCount, AbsolutePosition, Bookmark, current row); Rollback; DBEngine.Errors; state of each; Move(0) on each, state of each; Requery on each, state of each; close; read R through a fresh Workspace.
retentionNote: Designed r-txn-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
